narratives.title: Documents and Letters - HMT Dunera and Internment Collection

CreCreationNotes: This program was made on board of the Dunera ship in its way from Australia back to Liverpool. The programme is printed, black text on a white card ground, with a coloured image printed on the front cover. Handwritten notes outlining the voyage and it's stops, are on the back cover, in blue ink. This is a program for a variety of shows and musicals titled "We're in love!!!" produced by Capt. O'Gorman, Peter Land and Ray Martin. On the voyage from Australia to Liverpool the entertainment committee presented a variety ship's concert in the first class lounge. The ship went from Australia, through Auckland, then through Panama Canal where some internees were released early, and then to Liverpool. This specific concert was held on November 11th 1941, at 2:30 and 8:15 p.m. The dance in the show was devised by Max Lewinsky, and the music written and arranged by Ray Martin. The stage manager for this show was Bernard Bell.
